newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bourse tightens limits in B2 stocks group.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bourse tightens limits in B2 stocks group.

text.p: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) said in a notice issued to members it was tightening limits on the volume of transactions in its B2 stocks group.

"Members can do cumulative net business in any individual scrips upto 500,000 rupees only and gross cumulative business in all B2 group of securities taken together upto four million rupees only," the notice, issued over the weekend, said.
BSE said any member intending to do more business than these limits must get prior written permission from the exchange's executive director.
The limits would be effective from Monday, the BSE said.
